title: Confession and Inheritance
author: Rosalind Ravensworth
blurb: Dominic Sandoval, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
